physicalNotes: Radius 0.0918906 Jupiter radii from Barkaoui et al. 2024 (2024A&A...687A.264B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract): 6,569.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Barkaoui et al. 2024 (2024A&A...687A.264B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01258541 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.period: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 0.85737269789 d

sources.eccentricity: No archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular
sources.phase: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): transit mid-time 2458711.372904 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 55 min)
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
